descriptions.dial_stuck: Dial is stuck and will not move!
descriptions.dial_sticky_tight: Dial is very sticky and/or tight to turn
descriptions.dial_loose_spin: Dial is loose, seems to spin too easy and will not engage to open
descriptions.dial_drag: Dialing the combination, it does not unlock easily and have to dial it multiple times to unlock it
descriptions.dial_lost_combo: Lost or forgotten combination, probate, damaged in a burglary, or simply a broken dial lock
descriptions.dial_forgot_combo: I forgot how to dial my combination!

descriptions.no_heater_desiccant: I don't have a heater or desiccant in my safe
